rv5.vehicle_charge_note: PV2 can be set to vehicle charging: 600W at 12V or 1200W at 24V, 50A, 12-14.4V on a 12V battery. Using PV2 for the alternator removes it as a solar input. This build uses a Victron Orion instead so both PV ports can stay solar. Confirm with Bluetti.
rv5.clearance_note: Manual: at least 8 in (20 cm); the figure shows >= 200 mm / 7.87 in. Floor-mount round holes are the pattern for RVs. Keyhole wall slots are not for moving vehicles.
rv5.operating_temp_note: Spec table lists -4 F to 113 F, then load derating from 113 F to 131 F (45 C to 55 C). Storage -4 F to 131 F.

b4810.self_heating_note: Manual: built-in self-heating, works in freezing temperatures as low as -4 F. Heater wattage and power source are not in the extracted spec table. AWAITING BLUETTI.
b4810.cable_note: Manual recommends a cable larger than 4 AWG or 20 mm2. Do not put washers between terminal bolts and lugs.
b4810.keep_dry_note: Manual: do not use the product in water; if it gets wet, stop using it and do not reuse after drying. IP65 does not authorize an open underbody mount.

panel.weight_conflict_note: Callsun product page lists 65.65 lb. A retailer listing the same model family lists 29.8 lb. Both are recorded. Neither is silently preferred.
panel.price_note: Callsun page list price on 2026-10-06, marked Unavailable. Not a project quote.

orion_options.weight_note: Victron isolated-charger manual: 12 V input models weigh 1.8 kg (4 lb). Dimensions for 12 V input models: 130 x 186 x 80 mm.
orion_options.parallel: Victron states multiple units may be paralleled to increase output. Quantity is OPEN until the chassis alternator rating is known.
orion_options.why: This is the published Victron Orion charger that steps a 12 V alternator up to a 48 V lithium bank. The Orion XS 12/12 does not charge a 48 V bank.

generator_tie_in.rv5_expects: 120 V single-phase AC input. Charging stops when the battery is full. A 3-pin RV inlet is not included.
generator_tie_in.coach_generator_brand: UNVERIFIED for every unit. One 2027 dealer listing names Flex Power 4000.
